verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's docs state that all providers are called through the same completion() interface and every response (including tool/function calls) is normalized to the OpenAI Chat Completions schema, and a maintainer confirmed on HN that the proxy supports function-calling 'in the same way as the openai-python SDK' across providers. missing for 10: a concrete worked example showing tool_calls output normalized across two different providers, and independent hands-on verification beyond the single maintainer comment.
